description: watchdog.fired: the watchdog's notify arm fired — a running loop crossed one of the seeded rules (no-activity here, past its threshold) and nothing about it has moved. This kind is the notify arm only: the stop and block arms act through the loop's own kinds (loop.stopped / loop.blocked, actor {system,watchdog}), so this one means 'a rule asked a person to look'. A firing is once per (loop, rule, episode) — progress resets the episode and a second tick does not refire. The episode string is the signal's own progress marker (act:/pos:/run:/step:), so a client can tell a repeat of old quiet from fresh silence. Carries the notify hint (warning tone, title 'The watchdog needs your attention').
